With \(Q=(0,0)\), \(P=(0,4)\), \(R=(8,0)\).  
Since \(RS \perp QR\), \(RS\) is vertical: \(S=(8,8)\) or \(S=(8,-8)\).  
Since \(ST \perp RS\), \(ST\) is horizontal, so \(T\) is 3 units left or right of \(S\).

The whole-number distance occurs for \(S=(8,-8)\) and \(T=(5,-8)\):
\[
PT=\sqrt{(5-0)^2+(-8-4)^2}=\sqrt{25+144}=13.
\]

\boxed{13}
